Matrimandir Viewpoint

The golden sphere

The geodesic sphere at the centre of Auroville, finished in gold discs and surrounded by twelve gardens.

Photo: devaiah pa (CC BY-SA 2.0)

Construction began in 1971 and took decades. Inside is a white marble chamber with a single crystal lit by a shaft of sunlight, intended for silent concentration rather than worship. From the viewpoint you see the whole sphere and the gardens radiating out, each named for a quality its designers thought a person might cultivate.

About this route

Auroville was laid out around the Matrimandir on a plateau that had been stripped almost bare. Several million trees later the walk between its landmarks runs mostly in shade. This route takes in the Matrimandir gardens, the amphitheatre with the urn of soil from 124 nations, and the visitor centre.
